scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && eslint src && prettier --check src && vitest run && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
scripts.format: prettier --write src && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt
scripts.install:app: [ -n "$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY" ] || { echo "Set APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY first (see README)"; exit 1; }; tauri build && rm -rf /Applications/Coffer.app && cp -R src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Coffer.app /Applications/ && rm -rf src-tauri/target/release/bundle
scripts.reseed: DB="$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.apo.coffer/coffer.db"; [ -f "$DB" ] && mv "$DB" "$DB.$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).bak"; COFFER_SEED=1 tauri dev
